parameters.name: TemplateContent
parameters.description: The template content in JSON or YAML format.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: TemplateURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the file that contains the template body. The URL must point to a template that is located on a web server (HTTP or HTTPS) or in an OSS bucket (for example, oss://ros/template/demo or oss://ros/template/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou). The maximum length of the template is 524,288 bytes. If you do not specify the OSS region, the default value is the same as the RegionId parameter.
> You must specify only one of the following parameters: TemplateBody, TemplateURL, and TemplateId.
